title: Urth item prototype
description: One item prototype: data/world/<area>/items/<vnum>.yaml. Numbers here are rule inputs the engine stores and never interprets.

name.description: Short description used in sentences: a rusty sword.

keywords.description: What players type to refer to it. Lowercased at load.

description.description: Shown when it lies in a room: A rusty sword lies here. Defaults to '<Name> is here.'

slot.description: Required for armor. Weapons default to wield.

level.description: Row of the rules' item curve (docs/RULES.md 5.2).

baseline.description: Which baseline of the item curve; empty means the type's default.

mods.description: Stat modifiers while worn, by stat name.

material.description: Required for type material: the pool name a spell consumes (ash, wolf fang).

school.description: Required for type totem: the arcane school it unlocks.

sacrifice.description: The deity that accepts this as a great sacrifice at its temple.

burn.description: Rounds a light lasts while worn; 0 never goes out.

capacity.description: Weight a container holds; 0 is unlimited.
